verses.en: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
verses.pt: Vendo Balaão que parecia bem aos olhos do Senhor que abençoasse a Israel, não foi, como era costume, ao encontro dos encantamentos, mas voltou o rosto para o deserto.
verses.en_web: When Balaam saw that it pleased Yahweh to bless Israel, he didn’t go, as at the other times, to meet with enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
verses.en_bbe: Now when Balaam saw that it was the Lord's pleasure to give his blessing to Israel, he did not, as at other times, make use of secret arts, but turning his face to the waste land,

verses.en: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding in his tents according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.
verses.pt: E, levantando Balaão os olhos, viu a Israel que se achava acampado segundo as suas tribos; e veio sobre ele o Espírito de Deus.
verses.en_web: Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came on him.
verses.en_bbe: And lifting up his eyes, he saw Israel there, with their tents in the order of their tribes: and the spirit of God came on him.

verses.en: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
verses.pt: Então proferiu Balaão a sua parábola, dizendo: Fala Balaão, filho de Beor; fala o homem que tem os olhos abertos;
verses.en_web: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;
verses.en_bbe: And moved by the spirit, he said, These are the words of Balaam, son of Beor, the words of the man whose eyes are open:

verses.en: He hath said, which heard the words of God, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:
verses.pt: fala aquele que ouve as palavras de Deus, o que vê a visão do Todo-Poderoso, que cai, e se lhe abrem os olhos:
verses.en_web: he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:
verses.en_bbe: He says, whose ears are open to the words of God, who has seen the vision of the Ruler of all, falling down, but having his eyes open:

verses.en: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel!
verses.pt: Quão formosas são as tuas tendas, ó Jacó! as tuas moradas, ó Israel!
verses.en_web: How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your tents, Israel!
verses.en_bbe: How fair are your tents, O Jacob, your houses, O Israel!

verses.en: As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river’s side, as the trees of lign aloes which the LORD hath planted, and as cedar trees beside the waters.
verses.pt: Como vales, elas se estendem; são como jardins à beira dos rios, como árvores de aloés que o Senhor plantou, como cedros junto às águas.
verses.en_web: As valleys they are spread out, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which Yahweh has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.
verses.en_bbe: They are stretched out like valleys, like gardens by the riverside, like flowering trees planted by the Lord, like cedar-trees by the waters.

verses.en: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.
verses.pt: De seus baldes manarão águas, e a sua semente estará em muitas águas; o seu rei se exalçará mais do que Agague, e o seu reino será exaltado.
verses.en_web: Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted.
verses.en_bbe: Peoples will be in fear before his strength, his arm will be on great nations: his king will be higher than Agag, and his kingdom made great in honour.

verses.en: God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.
verses.pt: É Deus que os vem tirando do Egito; as suas forças são como as do boi selvagem; ele devorará as nações, seus adversários, lhes quebrará os ossos, e com as suas setas os atravessará.
verses.en_web: God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall eat up the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.
verses.en_bbe: It is God who has taken him out of Egypt; his horns are like those of the mountain ox; the nations warring against him will be his food, their bones will be broken, they will be wounded with his arrows.

verses.en: He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee.
verses.pt: Agachou-se, deitou-se como leão, e como leoa; quem o despertará? Benditos os que te abençoarem, e malditos os que te amaldiçoarem.
verses.en_web: He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”
verses.en_bbe: He took his sleep stretched out like a lion, and like a she-lion: by whom will his rest be broken? May a blessing be on everyone who gives you blessing, and a curse on everyone by whom you are cursed.

verses.en: And Balak’s anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed them these three times.
verses.pt: Pelo que a ira de Balaque se acendeu contra Balaão, e batendo ele as palmas, disse a Balaão: Para amaldiçoares os meus inimigos é que te chamei; e eis que já três vezes os abençoaste.
verses.en_web: Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.
verses.en_bbe: Then Balak was full of wrath against Balaam, and angrily waving his hands he said to Balaam, I sent for you so that those who are against me might be cursed, but now, see, three times you have given them a blessing.

verses.en: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honour; but, lo, the LORD hath kept thee back from honour.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, foge para o teu lugar; eu tinha dito que certamente te honraria, mas eis que o Senhor te privou dessa honra.
verses.en_web: Therefore, flee to your place, now! I thought to promote you to great honor; but, behold, Yahweh has kept you back from honor.”
verses.en_bbe: Go back quickly to the place you came from: it was my purpose to give you a place of honour, but now the Lord has kept you back from honour.

verses.en: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me, saying,
verses.pt: Então respondeu Balaão a Balaque: Não falei eu também aos teus mensageiros, que me enviaste, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I also tell your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,
verses.en_bbe: Then Balaam said to Balak, Did I not say to the men you sent to me,

verses.en: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the commandment of the LORD, to do either good or bad of mine own mind; but what the LORD saith, that will I speak?
verses.pt: Ainda que Balaque me quisesse dar a sua casa cheia de prata e de ouro, eu não poderia ir além da ordem do Senhor, para fazer, de mim mesmo, o bem ou o mal; o que o Senhor falar, isso falarei eu?
verses.en_web: ‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond Yahweh’s word, to do either good or bad from my own mind. I will say what Yahweh says’?
verses.en_bbe: Even if Balak gave me his house full of silver and gold, it would not be possible for me to go outside the orders of the Lord, doing good or evil at the impulse of my mind; whatever the Lord says I will say?

verses.en: And now, behold, I go unto my people: come therefore, and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, eis que me vou ao meu povo; vem, avisar-te-ei do que este povo fará ao teu povo nos últimos dias.
verses.en_web: Now, behold, I go to my people. Come, I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.”
verses.en_bbe: So now I will go back to my people: but first let me make clear to you what this people will do to your people in days to come.

verses.en: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
verses.pt: Então proferiu Balaão a sua parábola, dizendo: Fala Balaão, filho de Beor; fala o homem que tem os olhos abertos;
verses.en_web: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;
verses.en_bbe: Then he went on with his story and said, These are the words of Balaam, the son of Beor, the words of him whose eyes are open:

verses.en: He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:
verses.pt: fala aquele que ouve as palavras de Deus e conhece os desígnios do Altíssimo, que vê a visão do Todo-Poderoso, que cai, e se lhe abrem os olhos:
verses.en_web: he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty, Falling down, and having his eyes open:
verses.en_bbe: He says, whose ear is open to the words of God, who has knowledge of the Most High, who has seen the vision of the Ruler of all, falling down and having his eyes open:

verses.en: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.
verses.pt: Eu o vejo, mas não no presente; eu o contemplo, mas não de perto; de Jacó procederá uma estrela, de Israel se levantará um cetro que ferirá os termos de Moabe, e destruirá todos os filhos de orgulho.
verses.en_web: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and break down all the sons of Sheth.
verses.en_bbe: I see him, but not now: looking on him, but not near: a star will come out of Jacob, and a rod of authority out of Israel, sending destruction to the farthest limits of Moab and on the head of all the sons of Sheth.

verses.en: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Israel shall do valiantly.
verses.pt: E Edom lhe será uma possessão, e assim também Seir, os quais eram os seus inimigos; pois Israel fará proezas.
verses.en_web: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemies, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.
verses.en_bbe: Edom will be his heritage, and he will put an end to the last of the people of Seir.

verses.en: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.
verses.pt: De Jacó um dominará e destruirá os sobreviventes da cidade.
verses.en_web: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”
verses.en_bbe: And Israel will go on in strength, and Jacob will have rule over his haters.

verses.en: And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, and said, Amalek was the first of the nations; but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever.
verses.pt: Também viu Balaão a Amaleque e proferiu a sua parábola, dizendo: Amaleque era a primeira das nações, mas o seu fim será a destruição.
verses.en_web: He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, But his latter end shall come to destruction.”
verses.en_bbe: Then, turning his eyes to Amalek, he went on with his story and said, Amalek was the first of the nations, but his part will be destruction for ever.

verses.en: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwellingplace, and thou puttest thy nest in a rock.
verses.pt: E, vendo os quenitas, proferiu a sua parábola, dizendo: Firme está a tua habitação; e posto na penha está o teu ninho;
verses.en_web: He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, “Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock.
verses.en_bbe: And looking on the Kenites he went on with his story and said, Strong is your living-place, and your secret place is safe in the rock.

verses.en: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted, until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.
verses.pt: todavia será o quenita assolado, até que Assur te leve por prisioneiro.
verses.en_web: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, until Asshur carries you away captive.”
verses.en_bbe: But still the Kenites will be wasted, till Asshur takes you away prisoner.

verses.en: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this!
verses.pt: Proferiu ainda a sua parábola, dizendo: Ai, quem viverá, quando Deus fizer isto?
verses.en_web: He took up his parable, and said, “Alas, who shall live when God does this?
verses.en_bbe: Then he went on with his story and said, But who may keep his life when God does this?

verses.en: And ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.
verses.pt: Naus virão das costas de Quitim, e afligirão a Assur; igualmente afligirão a Eber, que também será para destruição.
verses.en_web: But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim. They shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber. He also shall come to destruction.”
verses.en_bbe: But ships will come from the direction of Kittim, troubling Asshur and troubling Eber, and like the others their fate will be destruction.

verses.en: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.
verses.pt: Então, tendo-se Balaão levantado, partiu e voltou para o seu lugar; e também Balaque se foi pelo seu caminho.
verses.en_web: Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.
verses.en_bbe: Then Balaam got up and went back to his place: and Balak went away.
